messages:
Maria: heads-up — SIEM spiking on `kms:Decrypt` failures for prod keys, ~120 alerts in last 10m. https://siem.prod.redwood.io/alerts/12345
Dan: I'm seeing them too. Caller principal looks like `svc/ci-runner@redwood-prod` and source IP 10.2.3.45. Could be rotation flapping.
Maria: ran a quick CloudTrail lookup; most events are DecryptFailure (status=AccessDenied) against alias/teams/prod-data-key. No obvious PutObject or data exfil activity.
Kevin: can you paste an example event?
Maria: sure
```
{ "eventTime":"2026-03-20T15:32:10Z", "eventName":"Decrypt", "userIdentity":{"principal":"svc/ci-runner"}, "errorCode":"AccessDenied", "sourceIPAddress":"10.2.3.45", "requestParameters":{"keyId":"alias/teams/prod-data-key"} }
```
Olivia: likely FP if CI is hitting an old key version after automated rotation. Two quick options: 1) correlate with KeyVersionChange events; 2) require DecryptFailure + abnormal egress/network for actual incident.
Ashok: agree but don't dismiss yet — if attacker has service account creds it could look like CI. Any recent CI pipeline changes?
Dan: build infra pushed a jobs-runner update 18m ago. Logs show retries to KMS after rollout.
Maria: confirmed: last pipeline deploy touched KMS alias mapping. I think it's rotation mismatch.
Olivia: proposed SIEM rule tweak: require DecryptFailure AND not in allowlist(principals) OR add a thresholding window >30 failures in 5m per principal. Here's pseudo-sigma:
```
selection:
  EventID: Decrypt
  Error: AccessDenied
condition: selection and not principal in (svc/ci-runner, svc/deployer) and count(principal) > 30 within 5 minutes
```
Dan: also suggest adding quick dashboard panel: 'DecryptFailure by principal' and lookup table for allowlisted service accounts and last-rotation timestamp.
Ashok: for containment, block 10.2.3.45 at edge for 15m and notify infra. If it breaks CI, we revert.
Maria: did block temporarily, monitoring. No additional alerts since block.
Olivia: I'll create a suppression rule scoped to that principal for 1h and add a follow-up ticket to reconcile alias mappings.
sec-bot: automated: suppression-rule created by Olivia | id=sr-20260320-1
Kevin: follow-up tasks: (1) Fix alias mapping in deploy (owner: Dan) (2) Add allowlist to SIEM (owner: Olivia) (3) Postmortem if we see recurrence (owner: Maria)
Maria: creating ticket now, linking alerts and CloudTrail. Thanks team :thumbsup:
Olivia: will add dashboard and update playbook with 'KMS rotation' checks.
